name: mti360
description: MTI 360 monorepo root — orchestration scripts only (no dependencies).

scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:frontend && pnpm run lint:backend
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:frontend && pnpm run typecheck:backend
scripts.test: pnpm run test:frontend && pnpm run test:backend
scripts.format: pnpm --filter @mti360/frontend format && uv run --locked --directory backend ruff format .
scripts.format:check: pnpm --filter @mti360/frontend format:check && uv run --locked --directory backend ruff format --check .
scripts.check:landing: git diff --quiet marketing-site-v1 -- index.html app.js styles.css
scripts.check: pnpm run check:landing && pnpm run check:env && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run build
scripts.infra:up: docker compose --profile infra up -d --wait postgres redis object-storage mailpit && docker compose --profile infra run --rm object-storage-init
scripts.stack:up: docker compose --profile infra --profile app up -d --build --wait postgres redis object-storage mailpit api frontend && docker compose --profile infra run --rm object-storage-init
